decisions.reason: As a current-generation replacement in a core voltage-measurement category, it remains a basic platform building block with broad reuse across customer projects.
The MQTT proxy extends connectivity for industrial and IoT use cases at relatively low maintenance cost, so it is still strategically worth keeping.
CO2 sensing fits education, building and monitoring applications well, although sensor-specific sourcing and calibration needs make it somewhat more exposed than core modules.

The touch panel is the most optional and niche accessory among the remaining launches, so discontinuing it is the most plausible way to free resources for stronger platform products and new development.
